needs.reason: The lockfile pins both dynamic versions; a reader of gradle.lockfile has the resolved versions without running Gradle.

traps: The build file asks for ranges ('3.+' and '[2.0,2.1)'); the versions are in gradle.lockfile: commons-lang3 3.17.0 and slf4j-api 2.0.16. Maven Central already has newer matches (commons-lang3 3.22.0, slf4j-api 2.0.20 as of 2026-11-14), so a resolution that ignores the lockfile gives different versions.
gradle.lockfile lists configurations, not scopes: both libraries are on compileClasspath and runtimeClasspath, so both are runtime; the test classpaths only inherit them.
empty=annotationProcessor,testAnnotationProcessor records locked configurations with no dependency; it is not a package.
No wrapper and no Gradle version anywhere: the Gradle that runs is whichever is installed.
The lockfile is the project's single lock file (Gradle 7+ format); there are no per-configuration files under gradle/dependency-locks/.
